# qpdf (WebAssembly)

Used by the Protect PDF and Unlock PDF tools. Encrypts (AES-256) and decrypts PDFs on the phone. Nothing is uploaded.

- Build: `@neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm` 0.3.0 (npm), files `qpdf.js` and `qpdf.wasm`, unchanged.
- Engine: QPDF, Apache License 2.0 (https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf).
- Browser wrapper: the npm package is licensed ISC.
